title: Scramble lines
description: A second statement style: the sentence in two or three offset lines, each opened by a mask that wipes across with a gold edge of light while its letters scramble and settle (GSAP ScrambleText, using the line's own letters, Korean too). Hairlines draw behind, the lines sit at slightly different depths.

props.text: required, one sentence, up to about 16 words
props.gold: a word or words: the line that holds them is set in gold serif

example.text: One story file becomes a deck and a website
